reason.message: No [app_proxy] section in shopify.app.toml or shopify.app.dev.toml, no appProxy/logged_in_customer_id/application/liquid handling in app/, workers/ or extensions/ (extensions are a Validation Function and an admin_link).
No app proxy is configured in shopify.app.toml/shopify.app.dev.toml and no route reads proxy parameters (shop, logged_in_customer_id, path_prefix, signature).
No theme app extension and no .liquid files: extensions/ contains only a function (cf-ready-validation) and an admin_link (support-link).

No scriptTagCreate/scriptTagUpdate/ScriptTag REST usage anywhere in app/, workers/ or extensions/; declared scopes are write_validations plus optional write_translations, read_locales, read_markets (shopify.app.toml:51-52), with no write_script_tags.
extensions/ contains only cf-ready-validation (Cart and Checkout Validation Function) and support-link (admin_link); no *.liquid files or theme app extension assets exist in the repository.
